$comment: Canonical v1 phone <-> wearable sync messages. Every platform must parse these.
Created by Story 10-6. docs/project-context.md and docs/architecture.md have listed this
path for months, but the file did not exist and the sibling card-valid.json is read by no
test on any platform — so the 'cross-platform fixture' mechanism was documentation only.
This file is consumed for real: core/wear-connectivity.test.ts (phone, TypeScript) and
watch-android SyncFixtureContractTest (Wear OS, Kotlin) both parse it, so a unilateral
change to the wire contract on either side fails a test rather than a customer's watch.
cardsSnapshot is phone -> wearable, the FULL card list. It is applied as a replace, so a
card absent from it is a card the user deleted (Story 10-6 AC7).
cardUsed is wearable -> phone and is the ONLY message a watch may send
(ADR-2026-06-09-001). usedAt is ISO-8601 UTC at MILLISECOND precision: the phone's dedup id
is '<cardId>:<usedAt>' and its validator rejects second precision outright.
barcodeImageBase64 is deliberately absent. watchOS receives it because it cannot render QR
codes; Wear OS renders all six formats locally with ZXing, so the Android path omits it
(Story 10-6 AC13). A platform that needs it adds it on its own path, not here.
